svg.title: Cake shop architecture
svg.desc: Customers and the baker reach CloudFront, which serves the two React apps from S3 and forwards API calls to API Gateway and Lambda. Orders are stored in DynamoDB; a stream triggers the notifier, which emails the customer through SES and alerts the baker through SNS. Failures land in a dead-letter queue watched by CloudWatch.
svg.text: How the cake shop fits together
Two small React apps, five Lambda functions and one table. Serverless, so it costs pennies outside December.
Payment is taken in person on collection,
so the site never handles card data.
